customManagers.description: Track the pinned ComplianceAsCode/content release in config/content.yaml

Track every tool version pinned as a *_VERSION env var in the workflows. One manager for all of them on purpose: a manager per variable name is how the helm-docs pin ended up annotated, named in packageRules, and tracked by nothing.

packageRules.description: Automerge GitHub Actions dependency updates once CI is green
Automerge the tool versions pinned in the workflows. These come from custom regex managers, which the github-actions rule above does not match, so without this they pile up.

prBodyNotes: After merge, refresh the pinned checksum and regenerate the charts:
make update-sha   # rewrites config/content.yaml sha512 for the new version
make generate     # regenerates charts/ and RULES.md
Review the diff of `charts/` and `RULES.md`: it shows exactly which rules and fixes changed between content releases.
packageRules.description: Never automerge a content bump: it changes the generated charts, and the diff of charts/ and RULES.md is the review.
